objective: Aislar por solo lectura la causa exacta de NO_CUADRA_REVISAR para 130MID 2026-09-11 y 2026-09-12. Runtime, encabezados POS, detalle por folio y diferencias monetarias. No escribir ni tocar Produccion.

queries.name: runtime_130mid_20260911_12
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (200) CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha,ventas_total,tickets_total,pax_total,ventas_abiertas,es_venta_abierta,es_corte_cerrado,fuente_original FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) IN ('2026-09-11','2026-09-12') ORDER BY fecha

queries.name: ticket_header_vs_detail_130mid_20260911_12
queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT CAST(tr.apertura AS date) AS fecha,ch.folio,CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS header_total,CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint) AS pax,CAST(ISNULL(ch.totaldescuentoycortesia,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS descuento_indicador FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE CAST(tr.apertura AS date) IN ('2026-09-11','2026-09-12') AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0), d AS (SELECT dc.foliodet AS folio,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS detalle_total FROM cheqdet dc GROUP BY dc.foliodet) SELECT TOP (200) h.fecha,h.folio,h.header_total,ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0) AS detalle_total,CAST(h.header_total-ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta,h.descuento_indicador,h.pax FROM h LEFT JOIN d ON d.folio=h.folio WHERE ABS(h.header_total-ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0))>0.05 ORDER BY h.fecha,ABS(h.header_total-ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0)) DESC,h.folio

queries.name: daily_header_detail_totals_130mid_20260911_12
queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT CAST(tr.apertura AS date) AS fecha,ch.folio,CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(19,4)) AS header_total,CAST(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS bigint) AS pax FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE CAST(tr.apertura AS date) IN ('2026-09-11','2026-09-12') AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0), d AS (SELECT dc.foliodet AS folio,SUM(CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS detalle_total FROM cheqdet dc GROUP BY dc.foliodet) SELECT TOP (200) h.fecha,SUM(h.header_total) AS header_total,SUM(ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0)) AS detalle_total,CAST(SUM(h.header_total)-SUM(ISNULL(d.detalle_total,0)) AS decimal(19,4)) AS delta,COUNT(*) AS tickets,SUM(h.pax) AS pax FROM h LEFT JOIN d ON d.folio=h.folio GROUP BY h.fecha ORDER BY h.fecha
